body:
Amends docs/designs/issue-watcher.md and issue-watcher-setup.md for the owner's 2026-11-14 Q2 decision (option 3): the watcher's claim keeps its default worktree level, so D2 claim-only is marked superseded (history kept), the poller still never assigns/comments/moves items, and downstream sessions per approval go from one to two. Records the owner's written acceptance for the first test session only; coverage of the second agent is not confirmed. The review-and-approval flow is marked to be designed, not part of this change. Docs only; tests/issue_watch 2655 passed.
